_comment: The reviewed v0.8.0 release authority owned by #90 (Deliver v0.8 extended static
governance). Required items are the high-level closed authorities that define v0.8
release intent, per #524's release-scope declaration instructions. #524 itself is not
listed as a required item: it is the acceptance procedure that proves this declared
scope through immutable Checkpoint B evidence, not release-scope content of its own.
#510 and #673 are explicitly optional/non-blocking for v0.8. #742 is delivered
repository-self-governance context, not a user-facing v0.8 release capability.

required_items.summary: Make extended-governance applicability and evidence explicit
Add native declared topology governance with capture/diff/verify
Add contract-surface exposure and DTO/version boundary governance
Add deterministic architecture metrics and enforced budgets
Federate external static diagnostics through bounded SARIF ingestion
Deliver Architecture Health, unified architecture PR report and badge
Fail closed on unknown CLI subcommands and invalid arguments with exit 2
Publish the v0.8 single-tool architecture-governance workflow guide
Make PR validation authoritative and publish installable main.N development builds

excluded_items.reason: Optional diagram interoperability adapter; native declared topology is already complete without it.
Optional human-output readability improvement for policy check; no product-governance semantic dependency.

delivered_items.reason: Repository self-governance debt freeze; protects implementation debt but is not a user-facing v0.8 release capability.
